payload.reason: The evidence describes a process of crowdsourced annotation involving both non-expert and expert annotators to label tweets related to job and employment, indicating the type of annotation performed is related to job-related content.

claims.text: The annotation performed is crowdsourced labeling of tweets related to job and employment.
Expert annotators reviewed and corrected tweets where crowdworkers disagreed, indicating a hybrid approach to annotation.
The process involved multiple rounds of annotations to improve labeling quality and inter-annotator agreement.
